name: Box Jump
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box about a foot back with feet shoulder-width apart and space to swing your arms.
Drop quickly into a quarter squat while swinging your arms behind you to load your legs.
Drive explosively upward through both feet and swing your arms forward to leap cleanly onto the box.
Land softly with both feet fully on top, stand tall to open your hips, and step down carefully one foot at a time.
tips: Land softly with both entire feet firmly on top of the box rather than catching the edge.
Step down between repetitions instead of jumping backward off the box to protect your Achilles tendons.
